title: Premium Surcharges, Assessments and Rating Settings — NFIP Dwelling Form Flood Policies (Write Your Own)
content:
## Premium Surcharges, Assessments and Rating Settings — NFIP Dwelling Form Flood Policies (Write Your Own)

The risk premium, the Increased Cost of Compliance premium and the Federal Policy Fee of an NFIP Dwelling Form Flood Policy (Write Your Own) are the figures the FEMA Risk Rating 2.0 rating engine returns and are recorded on the policy as rated. The surcharges, the assessment percentage, the statutory renewal cap and the Elevation Certificate settings below are the tier figures that sit alongside those rated figures.

| Item | Tenant Contents | Residential Condominium Unit | Manufactured Home | Secondary Single-Family Home | Primary Single-Family Home | Two-to-Four Unit Building |
|---|---|---|---|---|---|---|
| Tier can carry the lower HFIAA surcharge when the policy is designated a primary residence | Yes | Yes | Yes | No | Yes | No |
| HFIAA annual surcharge for a policy designated a primary residence (USD per term) | 25 | 25 | 25 | 25 | 25 | 25 |
| HFIAA annual surcharge for every other policy (USD per term) | 250 | 250 | 250 | 250 | 250 | 250 |
| Reserve Fund Assessment charged on the risk premium plus ICC premium (percent) | 18 | 18 | 18 | 18 | 18 | 18 |
| Statutory cap on the year-over-year increase of the risk premium line at renewal (percent) | 18 | 18 | 18 | 18 | 18 | 18 |
| Surcharge added to each term while the community is on probation (USD per term) | 50 | 50 | 50 | 50 | 50 | 50 |
| Elevation Certificate required to rate the policy under Risk Rating 2.0 | No | No | No | No | No | No |
| First floor height certified on an Elevation Certificate replaces the rating engine's estimated first floor height | Yes | Yes | Yes | Yes | Yes | Yes |

### Reading the table

- The HFIAA surcharge is 25 dollars per term for a primary-residence policy and 250 dollars per term for every other policy. Only a tier marked "Yes" in the first row can carry the 25-dollar figure; the **NFIP Dwelling Form – Secondary Single-Family Home** tier is marked "No".
- The Reserve Fund Assessment percentage is 18 percent on every tier, and the statutory cap on the year-over-year increase of the risk premium line stated in this schedule is 18 percent.
- The probation surcharge is 50 dollars per term.
- On every tier an Elevation Certificate is optional for rating ("No" in the certificate row), and a first floor height certified on an accepted certificate is used in place of the rating engine's estimate ("Yes").
